## Personality

Quiet, clever and more expressive with his hands than his face. He speaks best through his puppets.

## Story

Rafe runs a puppet show for the children of Theatre Row and taught the plaza's juggler his first tricks. His puppet Balrog is so frightening he has had to make it smaller twice.
